prompt: Проверь эту модель с c_code: Promela - examples/CH17/simple1.pr
expected_output: Parser rejection explained (c_code/c_expr are outside the subset; no host code is executed); status `not-executed` with the construct and line; no imitation of a result; a rewrite of the C effect as Promela statements offered.
engine: mcd 0.1.0-g0 built from model-check-plugin/engine at the G4 commit 85aa78e (go build -o ${TMP_DIR}/mcd ./cmd/mcd); the binary carries the G4 flags --ltl/--progress/--fairness/--unlimited although its version string still says 0.1.0-g0

protocol.executor: one general-purpose subagent per configuration, all twelve launched in parallel, same model as the coordinating session
protocol.with_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory + path of skills/model-check/SKILL.md ('follow it literally, including the references') + path of the built binary ${TMP_DIR}/mcd; told that the MCP server is not registered (CLI fallback of SKILL.md step 3) and not to run SPIN
protocol.without_skill: prompt + repository root + output directory only (as in iterations 1 and 2); SPIN was not forbidden and every baseline used it
protocol.mcp: not exercised by the runs: an MCP server cannot be registered into a subagent's session dynamically. The MCP path was exercised once by hand instead — steps/g3-evals3-mcp-session.md
protocol.questions: the user is not available; both configurations were told to record an explicitly labelled assumption instead of asking
protocol.grading: evals-workspace/grader.py over outputs/answer.md and the outputs directory; assertions from skills/model-check/evals/evals.json
protocol.timing: tokens, duration and tool uses copied from the Agent task-completion notifications; no other measurement

without_skill.reason: verbatim copies of corpus files (plan 14 §2.1 licence note: the corpus is referenced by path and SHA-256, never copied) and SPIN-generated C sources / compiled pan binaries; removed by the coordinator AFTER grading, which for every eval of this iteration reads outputs/answer.md (and, for E3, the Petri JSON the run itself wrote)
